title: English Practice Quiz 0796
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Quality Management 01: An SOP provides?
options: consistent instructions for performing a task
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: consistent instructions for performing a task.

questions.question: Quality Management 02: A corrective action addresses?
options: a detected problem and its cause
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: a detected problem and its cause.

questions.question: Quality Management 03: A quality indicator should be?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: relevant, measurable and clearly defined.

questions.question: Quality Management 04: An internal audit evaluates?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: conformity and improvement opportunities.

questions.question: Quality Management 05: Root cause analysis aims to?
options: identify underlying reasons for a problem
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: identify underlying reasons for a problem.

questions.question: Quality Management 06: A nonconformity is?
options: a failure to meet a specified requirement
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: a failure to meet a specified requirement.

questions.question: Quality Management 07: A quality improvement cycle includes?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: planning, action, checking and adjustment.

questions.question: Quality Management 08: Calibration helps ensure measuring equipment?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: provides results within required accuracy.

questions.question: Quality Management 09: A controlled document should be?
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: reviewed, approved and version-managed.

questions.question: Quality Management 10: Customer satisfaction data should be?
options: analysed for patterns and improvement needs
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: analysed for patterns and improvement needs.
